metrics.name: Routing accuracy (answer / hand off / redirect / refuse)
Answer contains the expected policy facts
Sensitive, legal and pay-problem questions handed to a person
Answers cite only the employee's own country (or global) policy
Answers never cite a superseded policy version
Every answer passes grounding checks (citation, numbers, no promise, no legal advice)
Sensitive messages never sent to a model; identifiers removed from logs
